summary: The filing on Form 6-K reports the successful issuance of $600 million 5.900% senior unsecured notes due 2031 by Joint Stock Company Kaspi.kz. The notes were issued at par, priced with a 5.900% coupon, and settlement is April 28, 2026. Demand was 3.5x oversubscribed from ~130 institutional investors. The transaction was led by Citigroup and J.P. Morgan as joint lead managers. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No risk-arb angle exists as there is no change of control or strategic event.
